title: Arched Green Botanical Wall
desc: An arched living-wall installation layered with caladium foliage, trailing grasses and light-green hydrangea over a moss base.

groups.label: Statement foliage
groups.blurb: Patterned caladium-style leaves carrying the wall's main texture.

items.role: White leaves veined and speckled in red, echoing the red-vein caladium patches across the wall.

groups.label: Trailing greens
groups.blurb: Hanging strands softening the arch and breaking the leaf mass.

items.role: Air grass hanging in long fine strands through the middle of the arch.
Soft feathery plumes threading through the greenery for fine texture.

groups.label: Filler foliage
groups.blurb: Veined and rounded leaves filling the gaps between statement pieces.

items.role: Green-yellow speckled arrow leaves filling the mid-tones of the wall.
White leaves with dark net veining adding the patterned filler patches.
Round eucalyptus sprigs adding small cool-green leaf circles.

groups.label: Floral accents
groups.blurb: Light green blooms breaking the all-foliage surface.

items.role: Light yellow-green hydrangea clusters concentrated at the top of the arch.
